description: This file implements inventory management services for an e-commerce platform, including reservation, release, commit, and restocking of inventory related to order lifecycle events. It contains functions for atomically managing stock counters with proper locking to prevent overselling.

classes.name: InventoryActionResult
classes.description: Immutable data class representing the result of an inventory operation, indicating whether changes were made and providing a detail message.

methods.name: None _ensure_non_negative(value: int, *, field: str)
methods.description: Validates that a given integer value is non-negative; raises ValidationError if the value is negative.

methods.name: InventoryActionResult reserve_inventory_for_order( *, order: Order, performed_by=None, idempotency_key: Optional[str] = None, )
methods.description: Reserves inventory for all items in an order, atomically updating stock_reserved counters while preventing overselling. Ensures idempotency and handles partial reservations.

methods.name: InventoryActionResult release_inventory_reservations_for_order( *, order: Order, performed_by=None, idempotency_key: Optional[str] = None, reason: str = "Reservation released", )
methods.description: Releases all remaining reservations for an order, decreasing stock_reserved without touching stock_on_hand, safe to repeat.

methods.name: InventoryActionResult commit_inventory_for_paid_order( *, order: Order, performed_by=None, idempotency_key: Optional[str] = None, )
methods.description: Converts reserved stock into actual sales, decreasing stock_reserved and stock_on_hand, and records an InventoryAdjustment. Safe for retries.

methods.name: InventoryActionResult restock_inventory_for_order_refund( *, order: Order, performed_by=None, idempotency_key: Optional[str] = None, )
methods.description: Restocks inventory after an order refund, increasing stock_on_hand based on the delta between committed and restocked quantities.
